description: Hand decisions the rules in wg.units and wg.decide cannot make. Every entry names its reason and evidence. `relabel` entries set columns on one NE row (`was` must still hold, or the build fails); `edges` entries fix one pair's edge (`edge`: true/false) and must name a candidate pair. Water policy (2026-11-05): borders along rivers count, borders across estuaries, firths and sea do not, and NE's 10m coastline (ocean layer) decides which water is sea. Seeded from overrides.json minus what the rules now reproduce: Ecuador's Napo/Tungurahua swap and 19 of the 38 added edges.
